crossRefs.note: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Elah
people.line: Father of Hoshea, the last king of Israel

people.name: Hoshea
people.line: The last king of Israel (northern kingdom).

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
translations.bsb: In the twelfth year of the reign of Ahaz over Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria nine years.
translations.kjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
translations.asv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel, and reigned nine years.
